    • getHitReward

      public static int getHitReward(String weaponId, boolean critical)
      Return the configured reward for one hit. Weapon IDs match GunSpec.id(). Missing hit rewards default to zero; a missing critical reward uses the normal hit reward.
      参数:
      weaponId - 武器 ID, 必须匹配 [a-z0-9_-]+
      critical - 是否暴击命中
      返回:
      该次命中的金币奖励, 配置缺失或 ID 非法时为 0
